title: Who can find you
summary: Privacy setting for phone-number discovery: shows whether a number is linked to the account (never the number), lets the person turn discovery off, and unlink the number.

confirmBy.description: After this date the number stops being discoverable until confirmed again.

phase.description: saving: a PUT or DELETE runs.

notes: Linking a number (Pix phone key or SMS code, phone-link.md) has no API yet; the screen shows bipe_phone_not_linked and no link button until it does.
The number is never shown, also not to its owner: the server keeps only a keyed hash.
Bipe logic: BipeAPIClient.myPhone and setDiscoverableByPhone (iOS); BipePrivacySettings.refreshDiscovery and setDiscoverableByPhone, BipeApiClient.phone and discovery (Android).
